title: Strict global and coefficient mapping towers
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, R=O_E lifted to the common section universe, and a scheme X. For a strict completed-coefficient derived tower Z, define integralDualizingMappingTower l E X Z on the opposite integral constructible category by realizing Z on the constant-ring sequence site, taking derived internal Hom from the constant input, then taking derived sections with values in strict R-module towers. Define integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E on all D(R)^op by internal Hom from a constant coefficient complex into the actual positive quotient tower R/(varpi^(n+1))[0]. Compute this closed Hom in the small-Hom tower localization and return to the standard localization by its canonical localization equivalence. Both constructions retain the strict tower index; neither uses a duality theorem or an existence choice for its data.
